frozen_nominal_replay: all three base models match visits 1–10 exactly
case_pass: coverage >= .88 and mean heading NEES in [0.5, 2.0]
cluster_draws: first 200 unchanged outer draws and rotated path case assignments from S2P_DRAWS
oracle_scale_scope: Candidate R_E1 is multiplied by kappa via c_L, with frozen R_cap,raw and r_bar. Frozen AR variance sigma_a2=rho*r_bar, AR process, and initial covariance are reused. White variance is max(kappa*R_E1-sigma_a2, 0.25*kappa*R_E1).
oracle_bias_scope: Subtract mu from candidate yaw in measurement update after unadjusted window and J selection.
